note: Byrd: all 27 pieces are on Phantasm's Complete Consort Music (Linn 2011) or another disc; Phantasm omits In Nomine a 5 No. 1 (Orlando Gibbons, Erato, has it). IMSLP has pages for the consort songs (Lullaby T 242, Constant Penelope T 233, Come to Me Grief T 244, My Mind to Me a Kingdom Is T 224, O That Most Rare Breast, Who Likes to Love) and for the In Nomines (T 395-399), none linked as imslpPage; T numbers could be added to those four song titles. Cambini: Lacepede keys/T numbers settled from RISM and IMSLP file names; Stradivarius track titles mislabel two keys (No. 1 'B-flat', T. 173 'G major'); Op. 21 Nos. 4-6 gain keys and T. 69-71. Cage and Cadman: nothing wrong. Caetani Op. 12: composition year uncertain (1904 IMSLP, 1905-06 it.wikipedia, score published 1907).
